title: WS2812B Display
shortDescription: Remastered 16x16 WS2812B matrix display controlled by a Raspberry Pi Pico W.
longDescription: Controlled via Wi-Fi TCP socket with a Raspberry Pi Pico W. It's both a usable decoration for my room and a project to learn more about embedded-specific things (lwip TCP networking, flash memory, timers, DMA and so on).
